## Feature-specific pricing

### Fast mode pricing

Fast mode provides significantly faster output for Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing.

| Model                           | Input          | Output         |
| ------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| Claude Opus 5.5                 | $8 USD / MTok  | $40 USD / MTok |
| Claude Opus 5 / Claude Opus 4.8 | $10 USD / MTok | $50 USD / MTok |
